user.title: DSC TLink server
user.description: Home Assistant will listen for your DSC PowerSeries NEO panel. Program the panel's communicator (installer section [851], integration groups) to point at this Home Assistant host and the port below.

error.port_in_use: The port is already in use. Choose another port or stop the service using it.
error.invalid_access_code: The access code is not valid for the selected encryption type. Type 2 requires 32 hex characters; type 1 requires at least 8 digits.
error.invalid_integration_id: Encryption type 1 requires an Integration ID of at least 8 digits.
